description: Get per-number SMS usage for the company: sends, delivered, failed, credits charged, last-sent time, and test-send count for each phone number the workspace has sent from. Use it to compare how the workspace's numbers are performing or to check what a number was used for before releasing it.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_sms_usage

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sms_usage` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

usage.description: Per-number SMS usage entries: fromNumber (E.164), totalSends, delivered, failed, creditsCharged, lastSentAt, testSends. Totals exclude test sends; test sends are counted separately.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
